recommendation: Provide psychosocial assessment and support for diabetes patients
implementation_steps: Assess and address psychosocial needs affecting diabetes management
Address mental health, housing, food insecurity, and financial barriers
Connect patients to community resources and social services
Provide counseling for diabetes distress and mental health concerns
Support care planning for patients with complex social or behavioral health needs
evidence_summary: Social worker interventions addressing psychosocial needs have been shown to improve diabetes self-management, reduce barriers to care, and enhance quality of life, particularly for patients facing multiple social determinants of health challenges.
citation: Care Management for Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: The Roles of Nurses, Pharmacists, and Social Workers
